params.liquidityNet: The resulting liquidityNet that exceeds the limit
params.maxLiquidityPerTick: The maximum allowed liquidity per tick
params.tick: The tick that would exceed the limit

FeesAccumulated(bytes32,uint128,uint128).details: Note locker is ommitted because it's always the extension of the pool associated with poolId

params.poolKey: Pool key containing token addresses and configuration
params.sqrtRatio: Initial sqrt price ratio for the pool

params.locker: The locker that is collecting fees
params.positionId: Identifier of the position specifying a salt and the bounds

params.balanceUpdate: Change in token balances (delta0 and delta1)
params.liquidityDelta: The change in liquidity for the specified pool and position keys
params.locker: The locker that is updating the position
params.positionId: Identifier of the position specifying a salt and the bounds

accumulateAsFees((address,address,bytes3.details: Only callable by the extension of the specified pool key. The current locker must be the extension. The extension must call this function within a lock callback

params.amount0: Amount of token0 to accumulate as fees
params.amount1: Amount of token1 to accumulate as fees

params.positionId: The key of the position for which to collect fees

completePayments().details: After tokens have been transferred, call completePayments to be credited for the tokens      that have been paid to core. The credit goes to the current locker. Compares current      balances with those recorded in startPayments to determine payment amounts.      The computed payments are applied to the current locker's debt.      Returns packed uint128 payment amounts (16 bytes each) in the same order as the tokens.

forward(address).details: Temporarily changes the locker to the forwarded address for the duration of the forwarded call.      Any additional calldata is passed through to the forwardee with no additional encoding.      Any data returned from IForwardee#forwarded is returned exactly as is. Reverts are bubbled up.

params.to: The address to forward the lock context to

getPoolFeesPerLiquidityInside(bytes32,in.details: The reason this getter is exposed is that it requires conditional SLOADs for maximum efficiency

params.poolId: The ID of the pool to fetch the fees per liquidity inside
params.tickLower: Upper bound of the price range to get the snapshot

returns._0: Accumulated fees per liquidity inside the bounds

initializePool((address,address,bytes32).details: Sets the initial price for a new pool in terms of tick

params.poolKey: Pool key identifying the pool to initialize

returns.sqrtRatio: Initial sqrt price ratio for the pool

lock().details: The entrypoint for all operations on the core contract. Any data passed after the      function signature is passed through back to the caller after the locked function      signature and data, with no additional encoding. Any data returned from ILocker#locked      is also returned from this function exactly as is. Reverts are bubbled up.      Ensures all debts are zeroed before completing the lock.

params.skipAhead: Number of ticks to skip for gas optimization
Number of ticks to skip for gas optimization

registerExtension((bool,bool,bool,bool,b.details: Extensions must call this function to become registered. The call points are validated against the caller address

params.expectedCallPoints: Call points configuration for the extension

params.extraData: The data to set on the position
params.poolId: ID of the pool for which the position exists
params.positionId: The key of the position to set extra data at

sload().details: Uses inline assembly to efficiently read multiple storage slots specified in calldata.      Each slot value is loaded using the SLOAD opcode and stored in memory.

startPayments().details: To make a payment to core, you must first call startPayments with all the tokens you'd like to send.      All the tokens that will be paid must be ABI-encoded immediately after the 4 byte function selector.      This function stores the current balance + 1 for each token to distinguish between zero balance      and uninitialized state. Returns the current balances of all specified tokens as ABI-encoded      raw bytes via assembly (no explicit Solidity return type).

swap_6269342730().details: Function name is mined to have a zero function selector for gas efficiency

tload().details: Uses inline assembly to efficiently read multiple transient storage slots specified in calldata.      Each slot value is loaded using the TLOAD opcode and stored in memory.

updateDebt().details: This is for deeply-integrated tokens that allow flash operations via the accountant.      The calling address is treated as the token address.The debt change argument is an int128 encoded immediately after the selector.The calldata length must be exactly 20 bytes in order to avoid this being called unintentionally.

params.positionId: The key of the position to update

returns.balanceUpdate: Change in token balances (delta0 and delta1)

updateSavedBalances(address,address,byte.details: The saved balances are stored in a single slot. The resulting saved balance must fit within a uint128 container

params.delta0: Change in token0 balance (positive for saving, negative for loading)
params.delta1: Change in token1 balance (positive for saving, negative for loading)
params.salt: Unique identifier for the saved balance
params.token0: Address of the first token (must be < token1)
params.token1: Address of the second token (must be > token0)

withdraw().details: The contract must be locked, as it tracks withdrawn amounts against the current locker's debt.      Calldata format: each withdrawal is 56 bytes: token (20) + recipient (20) + amount (16)      For native tokens, uses the NATIVE_TOKEN_ADDRESS constant and transfers ETH directly.

BoundsOrder().notice: Thrown when the order of the position bounds is invalid, i.e. tickLower >= tickUpper

BoundsTickSpacing().notice: Thrown when the ticks of the bounds do not align with tick spacing for concentrated pools

DebtsNotZeroed(uint256).notice: Thrown when the lock callback returns without clearing all the debts either via withdrawing from or paying to the accountant

ExtensionAlreadyRegistered().notice: Thrown when trying to register an already registered extension

ExtensionNotRegistered().notice: Thrown when trying to use an unregistered extension

FailedRegisterInvalidCallPoints().notice: Thrown when extension registration fails due to invalid call points

InvalidCenterTick().notice: Thrown when center tick is not between min and max tick

InvalidSqrtRatioLimit().notice: Thrown when sqrt ratio limit parameter given to swap is not a valid sqrt ratio

InvalidStableswapAmplification().notice: Thrown when amplification factor exceeds the maximum allowed value

InvalidTick(int32).notice: Thrown when a tick value is outside the valid range

InvalidTickSpacing().notice: Thrown when tick spacing exceeds the maximum allowed value

LockerOnly().notice: Thrown when a method is called by an address other than the current locker

MaxLiquidityPerTickExceeded(int32,uint12.notice: Thrown when a position update would cause liquidityNet on a tick to exceed the maximum allowed

MinMaxBounds().notice: Thrown when the bounds of the position are outside the pool's min/max tick range

NotLocked().notice: Thrown when an operation is made that affects debts without an active lock

PaymentOverflow().notice: Thrown if the contract receives a payment that exceeds type(uint128).max

PoolAlreadyInitialized().notice: Thrown when trying to initialize an already initialized pool

PoolNotInitialized().notice: Thrown when trying to operate on an uninitialized pool

SavedBalanceOverflow().notice: Thrown when saved balance operations would cause overflow

SavedBalanceTokensNotSorted().notice: Thrown when saved balance tokens are not properly sorted

SqrtRatioLimitOutOfRange().notice: Thrown when sqrt ratio limit is out of valid range

SqrtRatioLimitWrongDirection().notice: Thrown when the sqrt ratio limit is in the wrong direction of the current price

StableswapMustBeFullRange().notice: Thrown when stableswap pool positions are not at the min/max tick for the config

TokensMustBeSorted().notice: Thrown when tokens are not properly sorted (token0 >= token1)

UpdateDebtMessageLength().notice: Thrown if the contract receives a call to updateDebt that has a data length != 20

ExtensionRegistered(address).notice: Emitted when an extension is registered

FeesAccumulated(bytes32,uint128,uint128).notice: Emitted when fees are accumulated to a pool

PoolInitialized(bytes32,(address,address.notice: Emitted when a pool is initialized

PositionFeesCollected(address,bytes32,by.notice: Emitted when fees are collected from a position

PositionUpdated(address,bytes32,bytes32,.notice: Emitted when a position is updated

accumulateAsFees((address,address,bytes3.notice: Accumulates tokens as fees for a pool

collectFees((address,address,bytes32),by.notice: Collects accumulated fees from a position

completePayments().notice: Completes a payment operation by calculating and crediting token payments

forward(address).notice: Forwards the lock context to another actor, allowing them to act on the original locker's debt

getPoolFeesPerLiquidityInside(bytes32,in.notice: Returns the accumulated fees per liquidity inside the given bounds

initializePool((address,address,bytes32).notice: Initializes a new pool with the given tick

lock().notice: Creates a lock context and calls back to the caller's locked function

registerExtension((bool,bool,bool,bool,b.notice: Registers an extension with the core contract

setExtraData(bytes32,bytes32,bytes16).notice: Sets extra data for the position

sload().notice: Loads storage slots from the contract's persistent storage

startPayments().notice: Initiates a payment operation by recording current token balances

swap_6269342730().notice: Executes a swap against a pool

tload().notice: Loads storage slots from the contract's transient storage

updateDebt().notice: Updates debt for the current locker and for the token at the calling address

updatePosition((address,address,bytes32).notice: Updates a liquidity position and sets extra data

updateSavedBalances(address,address,byte.notice: Updates saved balances for later use

withdraw().notice: Withdraws tokens from the accountant to recipients using packed calldata
